# keyfactor_certificate_store_type (Data Source)

Reads an existing Keyfactor Command Certificate Store Type by integer ID or short name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a certificate store type by short name
data "keyfactor_certificate_store_type" "by_name" {
  identifier = "K8STLSSecr"
}

# Look up a certificate store type by numeric ID
data "keyfactor_certificate_store_type" "by_id" {
  identifier = "109"
}

# Reference computed attributes
output "store_type_id" {
  value = data.keyfactor_certificate_store_type.by_name.id
}

output "supports_add" {
  value = data.keyfactor_certificate_store_type.by_name.supports_add
}

output "properties" {
  value = data.keyfactor_certificate_store_type.by_name.properties
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Integer ID or short name (e.g. PEM, JKS, K8STLSSecr) of the certificate store type.

### Read-Only

- `blueprint_allowed` (Boolean) Whether blueprint provisioning is allowed.
- `capability` (String) Capability string.
- `custom_alias_allowed` (String) Whether custom aliases are allowed.
- `discovery_job_type` (String) GUID of the discovery job type.
- `enrollment_job_type` (String) GUID of the enrollment job type.
- `entry_parameters` (Attributes List) Entry parameter definitions for certificate entries in stores of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entry_parameters))
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the certificate store type (as a string).
- `import_type` (Number) Import type identifier.
- `inventory_endpoint` (String) Inventory job endpoint path.
- `inventory_job_type` (String) GUID of the inventory job type.
- `local_store` (Boolean) Whether the store is a local store.
- `management_job_type` (String) GUID of the management job type.
- `name` (String) Display name of the certificate store type.
- `password_entry_supported` (Boolean) Whether per-entry passwords are supported.
- `password_store_required` (Boolean) Whether a store-level password is required.
- `password_style` (String) Password style.
- `power_shell` (Boolean) Whether the store type uses PowerShell.
- `private_key_allowed` (String) Whether private keys are allowed: Forbidden, Optional, or Required.
- `properties` (Attributes List) Property definitions for stores of this type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))
- `server_registration` (Number) Server registration type.
- `server_required` (Boolean) Whether server credentials are required.
- `short_name` (String) Short/programmatic name.
- `store_path_type` (String) Store path type hint.
- `store_path_value` (String) Store path value or template.
- `supports_add` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports adding certificates.
- `supports_create` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports creating stores.
- `supports_discovery` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports discovery.
- `supports_enrollment` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports enrollment.
- `supports_remove` (Boolean) Whether the store type supports removing certificates.
